svg.title: How Model Atlas turns observed results into four scores
svg.desc: Observed benchmark results are gathered for every model at every reasoning effort. In the example, Model A at max effort has every result; its high and low efforts miss some, which are estimated from another effort of the same model, and Model B's gap is estimated from its other benchmarks. Model C has too few results, so its gaps stay missing. Estimates never count as direct evidence. Benchmark results are rescaled so the weakest observed result is 0 and the strongest 100, then feed Intelligence, which also draws on head-to-head comparisons on shared benchmarks, and Agentic, which adjusts results within a bound for token efficiency. Time and cost per task, with provider speed and prices, are compared with models of similar quality to give Speed and Value. Every score is discounted where evidence is thin, and the Trust Me Bro and Slop community indexes nudge Intelligence within a small limit.
